title: Coolant Adapters for Ford 6.7L Diesel Engines
lead: MOC has developed 2 new adapters to service the cooling systems in Ford 6.7L Diesel vehicles (Part Nos. 94345 & 94346). These adapters connect at the top radiator hose.
